preamble: Imperius is a constitutional monarchy created on the Boothboys Minecraft server. A citizen of Imperius is called an Imperium.

laws.title: Departments, Roles & Powers
rules: Imperius has six departments. Department roles may be held by multiple people, but each person may manage no more than two departments.
Resources and Projects — Amethyst Flow trim; Head: Paddcake2016. Oversees construction, money, resource stockpiles, and approval of building projects.
Combat — Redstone Flow trim; Head: ImmortalPrince63. Oversees gear, weapons, combat training, and military readiness.
War — Redstone Flow trim; Head: ImmortalPrince63. Oversees military strategy and works with the King on matters of war.
Agriculture — Gold Flow trim; Head: HYPERIOUS12. Oversees the food supply and the creation of food-producing farms.
Medicine — Emerald Flow trim; Head: DirtGrub58. Oversees potions and brewing.
Justice — Gold Flow trim; Head: HYPERIOUS12. Oversees law and the creation of new laws.

laws.title: The Crown & Royal Powers
rules: The King is William Holoborrow. He may veto or deny any action by a department leader.

The King appoints two Advisors, Darcy and Parker, who help him make decisions about Imperius's future. Advisors wear Netherite Dune trim; the King wears Diamond Flow trim; the Prince wears Iron Flow trim.
Citizens who do not hold a rank may not wear armor trims. Anyone wearing Diamond Flow trim who is not the King must change it, unless they are the ruler of another kingdom.
The King may surrender to or declare war on opposing kingdoms, with guidance from the Head of War.
The King controls decisions about land within Imperius. In this context, 'owns' means the King controls decisions about the land for the country; other players may still own the land.
The King holds authority over mining, farming, and combat operations within Imperius, except for an ocean store if Nate builds one.
The King decides who may join or be expelled from Imperius and commands the Imperium military, including decisions to go to war or surrender.
The King may call a kingdom-wide meeting at any time. Members should make a reasonable effort to contact members who are offline.
The King oversees taxation.
The King may be deposed if every Imperium agrees; this decision cannot be vetoed.

laws.title: Parliament
rules: The King leads Parliament and has five votes. Each Advisor has three votes, department heads have two votes, and citizens have one vote.
An Advisor who is also a department head retains three votes total.
A proposal passes when at least 51% of votes favor it.
If a decision would be extremely detrimental to Imperius, the King may veto it if at least one other player agrees that it is detrimental.
The Head of Justice maintains order in Parliament.
All votes must affect all citizens of Imperius.

laws.title: Tax
rules: For produced resources, one raw resource per stack must be paid to the government. For example, a player who harvests wheat must pay one wheat per stack.
The tax on Netherite is one item per 32 Ancient Debris.
Taxes are collected every Saturday.

laws.title: Court & Powers of the Court
rules: The court may order players to pay fines or serve jail time.

A judge decides minor cases, such as stealing. Major cases—including murder, mass stealing, attacks on other teams, building without a permit, treason, stealing from the King, killing a player's pet, and citizens wearing armor trims—must have a jury of at least two people.
A jury verdict requires two-thirds agreement. The judge has a vote; conviction requires agreement from two jurors, or one juror and the judge.

If the Judge is offline, the King may handle cases. If both are offline, the case passes down the Imperium's rankings to the highest-ranking available person. If only a citizen is available, the trial is postponed.
A citizen has the right to a trial within one week of being caught. If the trial does not happen within that time, the accused is free of charges.

Once a judge is assigned to a case, that judge cannot be replaced by someone who logs on later, even if the new arrival has a higher legal rank. If the assigned judge is accused of a major crime, the highest-ranking available person in the legal system becomes judge.

People involved in a case must represent themselves unless the accused has five or more crimes on their record. In that case, they must have a representative from the legal ladder, selected from the bottom upward. The representative cannot be replaced.
A verdict stands unless evidence proving innocence is found.
The Head of Justice may offer plea deals to simplify sentencing. The lawyer and accused must both accept the deal before its punishment takes effect.
Anyone accused of a violent crime, such as murder, is held in prison while the trial is in progress.
The King cannot be convicted unless he commits the crime himself or commits mass murder of citizens. In that event, the next in line to the throne takes his place.

laws.title: Military Powers
rules: The military may recruit any member of Imperius who is not an Advisor to fight.
The Head of Combat may declare war with the King's permission.
The military may receive up to 20% of Imperius's weekly budget.
The military may build military bases on no more than 5% of Imperius land.

laws.title: Miscellaneous
rules: Taylor Swift is illegal.
Chess is the national sport.
The national holiday is November 5, because why not.
Chicky31889 is cool, and saying otherwise is wrong.
Anyone may join Imperius at any time.

laws.title: Conditions of Court
rules: The King and two other players chosen by His Majesty will serve as the jury and decide whether the defendant is guilty or innocent.
Judge Thomas maintains order in court and determines the defendant's final punishment according to the Book of Punishment.
Violence is forbidden in court. Anyone who commits violence will be punished without a trial (see the Book of Crimes).
Only players holding a gavel (a specific mace) may speak. The Judge and the King each have a personal gavel; the defendant and accuser share a wooden sword while presenting their arguments.
Even if the defendant is found innocent, a temporary separation order must be issued: 10–50 blocks for 1–10 days. The Judge and/or the King decides the distance and duration.
Highly offensive language and threats are forbidden and may result in a ban.
Rigging a trial is an extremely serious crime and will be punished severely (see the Book of Punishment).

laws.title: Conditions of Prison
rules: Upon entering prison, the prisoner must hand all weapons, money, food, armor, and equipment to the Warden, who is appointed by the King. The Warden and other players may not use confiscated items for personal gain. All confiscated property must be returned when the sentence ends.
The prisoner is to receive one piece of bread per day.
With the King's permission, the prisoner may have five minutes of supervised yard time under the Warden's watch.
The prisoner's only permitted activity is mining cobblestone with a wooden pickaxe from the cobblestone generator inside their cell.
Each cell must be bare except for a bed, a torch, a cobblestone generator, and a lectern containing the books of law and punishment.
Escaping from prison will carry serious consequences (see the Book of Punishment).

For extremely serious crimes, solitary confinement may be imposed (see the Book of Punishment). The cell will have lava walls, measure 1 × 1 × 1 block, and provide a single standing place on an end rod. Food will be delivered through a dropper once every two days.
All prisoners must be treated humanely.

laws.title: Conditions of Taxation
rules: Taxes are collected once every seven days, on Saturday.
An Imperium that does not pay its taxes may be taken to court and found guilty (see the Book of Punishment).
A tax collector who uses collected taxes for personal gain will be taken to court and seriously punished.
The King is exempt from taxation.
Tax is one item per stack.
Items found before the Constitution was established are tax-free.
Donating gear to new players counts as a tax write-off.
If you mine at least half a stack, tax must be paid.

laws.title: Conditions of Rationing
rules: The Head of Agriculture distributes food.
If a player has fewer than five hunger bars, basic food is free. At five hunger bars or more, food must be purchased from the restaurant.
If the Head of Agriculture is absent, a player in need may take wheat from the wheat ring to make bread. Replant the wheat after harvesting.
The Head of Agriculture is primarily responsible for maintaining the wheat ring and other food sources.
The King may take food whenever he wishes. More exotic food must be purchased from the restaurant.

laws.title: Conditions of Construction
rules: All structures require approval from the Head of Construction, and builders must possess a physical, legal permit.
A builder may pay the Head of Construction to assist with a project. The cost depends on the size of the build.
